notes: Fabricated name killed: 'Twirl' replaced by the real E, The Weirding, across eight content fields (kit is authority). Also softened 'bounces' to the recast/return mechanic per Riot's Q text. Packet suspectName 'Farm Baleful Strike' is a false positive (Veigar's real Q). Chart: full rows 0-5 moved to agree with content win[] (Aurora x5, Veigar), matching the packet; win[] untouched. needs-antiheal landed in dontsFull[2].d (Oblivion Orb vs Spirit Abjuration). Note her E is a damaging blast followed by a backward hop (disengage) rather than a free dodge-dash — wording kept directional without overclaiming. All 20 lintFindings addressed.
